notes.title: Minor release day bug fixes
notes.notes:
Turns out i overlooked some bugs before releasing the game.

So i did some fixing.

Bug fixes:
- Rebirth screen now actually works.
- no longer start in profile screen.
- profile picture isn't dark anymore.

Features:
- You now start in windowed mode with a re-sizable window.

Bugs found:
- Resizing the window causes the themes page to glitch out due to it maintaining it's size. Will be fixed soon.

notes.title: An important little update.
notes.notes:
We at ShadowClaw really like to listen to the community. Hereby we've decided to remove all steam inventory item ideas from this video game to make it more enjoyable.

 What will happen now? 

We've chosen to make the game paid instead of free to play so that we could still make money off of this project. 

With this change though, we're going to make the game worth your money. We're going all out to make sure you have the best experience, all for only $3.99.
And we will still implement your cheese icons into our game for no additional cost! Just send them to us on our Discord server once it goes public and we will most likely add it to the game!

We do apologize for thinking steam items was a good idea. I hope this announcement clears everything up for all of you, and we hope to see you clicking soon!
